How it works

A real website build, in four plain steps

This is a website-building service, not an instant generator. You supply the facts about your business, and Webco Media turns them into your website.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Choose your package

    Pick Essential or Professional, choose a new .uk or .co.uk domain or tell us the one you already own, add your details and pay securely by card at checkout.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Tell us about your business

    After payment you get a private link to an online brief. Add your courses, locations, contact details, logo and photos. Your progress saves, so you can come back to it.

  3. 3

    Step 3: We build and customise your website

    Webco Media starts from the demo for your package and customises it with your branding, wording, courses and locations. A person does this work; it is not an automatic website generator.

  4. 4

    Step 4: Review and launch

    You see your website before it goes live. Your client area shows which stage it has reached, and Webco Media is on the phone if you would rather talk it through.

Straight answers

Questions people ask before they buy

Spending £595 or £995 deserves honest answers, including about costs after the first year. If yours is not here, ask us.

Before you order

Can I speak to someone before ordering?

Yes, and plenty of people do. Call Webco Media on 01934 228 015, email hello@webcomedia.net, or use the enquiry form further down this page.

You do not need to create an account or pay anything to ask a question, and nobody will chase you for a decision.

Is the quoted price the full website price, or are there additional charges?

The price you see is the website fee, charged once at checkout: £595 for Essential or £995 for Professional. It covers the design and build of your website and, for the first year, hosting, SSL, domain setup and business email.

Ongoing costs come later and are shown before you pay: standard hosting is £99/year after the first 12 months, or you can add Managed Care instead (see below). Domain renewals are charged when they fall due. A new domain ending .uk or .co.uk is included; other endings may cost extra.

Online booking, ecommerce and custom software are not part of either package. If you need them, we quote separately.

Do I have to pay everything upfront?

The website fee is one card payment at checkout. Hosting is not charged at checkout: standard hosting is first billed one year later, and Managed Care, if you choose it, has its first payment 30 days after checkout.

We do not offer instalments on the website fee through this page. If spreading the cost matters to you, call or email and ask before you order.

Can I use a domain name I already own?

Yes. At checkout, choose that you already have a domain and enter it. We connect it to your website and to your business email.

If you need a new one, you can search for a .uk or .co.uk name during checkout. Either package can also replace the website you have now.

Your website

Will my website look exactly like the demo?

No. The demos are starting points that show the layout, structure and style your website begins from. Your finished website carries your own name, branding, wording, course details, locations and photos, so it reads as your business rather than a copy of an example.

Both demos use fictional training businesses with sample content, which is why you will see made-up places and phone numbers on them.

How much can the design be customised?

Your logo and brand colours (if you have them), your wording, images, courses, locations and contact details are all tailored to you. If you have no logo or colours yet, we follow the look of the demo you chose.

The overall page layout and structure follow the demo for your package, which is what keeps the price straightforward. If you want something noticeably different, ask before you order and we will tell you honestly whether it fits the package or would need a separate quote.

How long will it take to build?

It depends mostly on how quickly you can send us your content: the brief, logo, photos, and details of your courses and locations. We do not promise a fixed number of days here, because a rushed website helps nobody.

Your client area shows which stage your website has reached. If you have a deadline, tell us before you order and we will say whether it is realistic.

What if I want changes to the first version?

You review your website before it goes live and can tell us what needs changing. We work through it with you.

We have not set a fixed number of revision rounds. Changes that go beyond the package, such as extra sections or a different layout, would be quoted separately.

Can I update courses, prices and locations later?

Yes, but you do not edit the website yourself. You ask Webco Media to make the change.

With Managed Care, routine changes such as service, pricing and location updates are covered by an allowance of about 30 minutes a month. Unused time does not roll over, and larger changes are quoted separately. Without Managed Care, ask and we will quote for the change.

What if I start with Essential and need more later?

That is a normal route. Essential suits one main location and straightforward course information. When you need separate pages for several courses or locations, we move you onto the Professional Website and quote that work.

After the first year, and leaving

What happens after the first year?

The first 12 months of hosting are included. After that, standard hosting is £99/year, billed yearly, unless you have Managed Care, which includes hosting. Domain renewals are charged when they fall due.

We will let you know before renewals so nothing lapses by surprise. Please keep your contact details up to date.

What is included in Managed Care?

Managed Care is optional. It is £39/month with Essential and £59/month with Professional.

Hosting, maintenance, routine content updates and support, with a 30-day trial from checkout. Hosting is included, so a separate hosting renewal is not required while Managed Care is active. About 30 minutes of routine content changes a month, including reasonable service, pricing and location updates. Unused time does not roll over. Larger changes are quoted separately.

You can cancel Managed Care by giving us notice. Hosting then continues on the standard renewal basis unless you cancel hosting as well.

Do I own my website and domain name?

Your logo, wording and photos stay yours; when you send us material you confirm you have the right to use it. Your domain is registered using the details you give us at checkout.

We have not published full ownership and transfer terms for the finished website files on this page. If that matters to you, email hello@webcomedia.net before you order and we will answer in writing.

Will my website appear on Google?

Both packages are built with search in mind, and the Professional Website adds a page for each course and each location, so a local search has somewhere sensible to land.

But nobody can honestly promise a position on Google. Where you appear depends on your area, your competitors, your content and time. We do not guarantee rankings, traffic or enquiries.

What happens if I want to leave Webco Cloud?

Hosting renews yearly, so you can choose not to renew. Managed Care can be cancelled by notice. Refunds are not automatic once work has started, but if something has gone wrong on our side, contact us and we will look at a fair remedy (see the terms of service).

Moving your domain or website files to another provider is something we deal with case by case. Ask us before you order if you want to know what that would involve, at hello@webcomedia.net.
